curator.description: DID of the curator account that owns the featuredItem records.

activeOnly.description: When true, only active items, ordered by position (splash carousel). When false, the full archive ordered newest-featured first.

main.description: List admin-curated featured items from the curator repo, joined to their subject posts and hydrated with author + live engagement counts. `activeOnly=true` returns the splash set ordered by admin position; otherwise returns the full archive newest-first. `curator` is the curator account DID.
